# QR Code generator origin

Copied without modification from `CentralScrutinizer` commit
`4af8ca18d9486c6ada5992098810a4fa2719c89a` on 2026-08-08. The files were
originally imported there at commit `2c2afd0ec0f729c8061b9ad57e6402f0cb2c6d0a`.

Upstream is Project Nayuki's C QR Code generator. It is MIT licensed; the full
license text is preserved in `qrcodegen.h` and `qrcodegen.LICENSE`.
